Conclusions: Our case provides an unusual description of SPS presenting as status dystonicus in a patient with severe muscle rigidity and spasms. We provide a photograph and can provide a video demonstration of the involuntary movements, which we hope will aid other practitioners in the early recognition and treatment of this condition. We also demonstrate that IVIg may improve the clinical course of this syndrome. References: 1) Fahn S, Jancovic J, Hallett M, editors. Principles and Practice of Movement Disorders. 2nd ed.
